cmd.internal_affairs.invalid_gold.zhHant: 「{0}」的內政每月投入金不足，至少需要 {1} 金。
cmd.internal_affairs.invalid_gold.en: "{0}" does not meet the minimum monthly gold for internal affairs. At least {1} gold is required.

cmd.internal_affairs.not_enough_gold.zhHant: 「{0}」金不足，無法支付本月 {1} 金執行內政。
cmd.internal_affairs.not_enough_gold.en: "{0}" does not have enough gold to pay this month's {1} gold for internal affairs.

cmd.internal_affairs.paused_insufficient.zhHant: 「{0}」因金不足，無法支付本月 {2} 金，內政「{1}」已自動暫停。
cmd.internal_affairs.paused_insufficient.en: "{0}" could not pay this month's {2} gold, so internal affairs "{1}" was automatically paused.

cmd.internal_affairs.auto_resumed.zhHant: 「{0}」資金已足，內政「{1}」由「{2}」自動恢復執行，本月金 {3}。
cmd.internal_affairs.auto_resumed.en: "{0}" has enough gold again. Internal affairs "{1}" automatically resumed under "{2}". Monthly Gold {3}.
